sources.what: How Wikipedia begins to tell of each country of the game and of its flag: the opening of each page that the sheets of the countries lead to (public/data/profiles/<country>.json: read and readFlag), in Spanish and in English, as plain text. pages, by language:title, the title being the one the sheet names: the text (text), the revision of the page it was read from (rev) and, when that title leads to another page, the title of that one (title).
